events_refund_check.name: events_refund_check
events_refund_check.value: "events"."is_refund_available" = false or ("events"."refund_cutoff_hours" is not null and "events"."refund_percent" between 0 and 100)

ticket_types_quota_check.name: ticket_types_quota_check
ticket_types_quota_check.value: ("ticket_types"."kind" = 'first_come') = ("ticket_types"."quota" is not null) and ("ticket_types"."quota" is null or "ticket_types"."quota" >= 1)

enrollments_refund_check.name: enrollments_refund_check
enrollments_refund_check.value: ("enrollments"."refund_percent" is null) = ("enrollments"."refund_cutoff_hours" is null) and ("enrollments"."refund_percent" is null or "enrollments"."refund_percent" between 0 and 100)

payments_paid_at_check.name: payments_paid_at_check
payments_paid_at_check.value: "payments"."status" not in ('paid', 'refunded') or "payments"."paid_at" is not null or "payments"."recovery_hold" is not null
